'''Selame Necoine''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Fy|1084}}.

==History==
Selame held the position for fifty-five years until her death in {{Ne|5}}. She was [[Deane Aryman]]'s successor and [[Rabayn Marushta]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She failed to capitalize on Deane's earlier successes as mediator and negotiator to put an end to the [[Hundred Years War]], and the war continued for another thirty years. Still, she was an Amyrlin of average strength.
